utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik. I’m still sorting the time and supplies, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess - just send the updated time and place, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help on Saturday. Send me the time and what to bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. Please come at 9 a.m. to the front porch, and bring any basic tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help. What time do you need me there on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina. Around 9 a.m. on the front porch should work well for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — if you can make it this Saturday on the front porch, just let me know and I’ll tell you what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can make it — just let me know what to bring, and I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help. Is it still around 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina, but it’s changed to Sunday at the community center now, still around 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — I really appreciate it. I’m still sorting the exact time, but I’ll send you a reminder as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Tess. Just send me the reminder when you know the time, and I’ll be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday works for me. Let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — I’ll let you know what to bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I’m setting up the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I can give you the timing and a simple task to handle.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — what time should I be there, and what task do you want me to handle?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
